input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone—nothing less will do. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any other details.
It looks like the speed test couldn’t run because there’s no connection at the moment. What should I do next to get my mobile data working and achieve excellent speed?

Here’s what I see on my status bar:
- Signal strength is excellent.
- I’m connected to a 5G network.
- Mobile data is currently disabled.
- VPN is connected.
- Battery is at 80%.

What should I do next to get my mobile data working?
I’ve turned mobile data on. The status bar now shows that data is enabled, and I’m still connected to a 5G network with excellent signal strength. What should I do next?
I’ve disconnected the VPN. The status bar now shows that VPN is off, and everything else looks the same—excellent signal, 5G, and mobile data enabled. What should I do next?

I tried running a speed test, but it still says there’s no connection. What should I do next? This is getting a bit frustrating since everything looks like it should be working, but I still can’t get online.
I checked, and Data Saver mode is already turned off on my phone. What should I try next?

I rebooted my device, but I still can’t get any internet connection—speed test is still failing with “No Connection.” This is getting pretty frustrating. What else can we try to get excellent internet speed?
I checked, and my SIM card is active and working properly—no issues there. What should I try next to get my mobile data working at excellent speed?
Yes, I am currently abroad in France, so I’m outside my home network. Please go ahead and enable data roaming for me.
Data roaming is now enabled on my phone. What should I do next to check if my mobile data is working at excellent speed?

I tried running the speed test again, but I’m still getting “No Connection.” My mobile data just isn’t working, even with data roaming enabled. What else can we try? I really need excellent internet speed.

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.
